info.name: I-Drive API - Automated Tests
info.description:
Automated tests for every I-Drive REST endpoint.

Before each run: `node postman/seed.js` (creates/resets the test rider, driver and candidate and clears their rides).
Then run the whole collection in order (Runner, or `npm run test:api`).

File uploads use fixtures/ relative to the working directory: set Postman's working directory to the postman/ folder.
The estimate and request steps call Mapbox, so MAPBOX must be set and the machine must be online.
